inputs.description: Resource identifier as CloudTrail records it - the name or id, not the full ARN.
CloudWatch namespace, e.g. AWS/RDS, AWS/Lambda, AWS/ECS, AWS/ApplicationELB, AWS/DynamoDB, AWS/ElastiCache, AWS/EC2.
Metric to fetch, e.g. CPUUtilization, DatabaseConnections, ReadLatency, Errors, Duration, Throttles, TargetResponseTime.

CloudWatch dimension key for this resource type: DBInstanceIdentifier (RDS), FunctionName (Lambda), ServiceName (ECS), LoadBalancer (ALB), TableName (DynamoDB), CacheClusterId (ElastiCache), InstanceId (EC2). A key that does not match the resource type returns zero datapoints.
Value for that dimension. Usually the same as resource_name; ALB wants the app/name/id form.
ISO8601 UTC start of the window, e.g. 2026-09-03T12:00:00Z. Set this earlier than the alarm if you want to see what preceded it.
ISO8601 UTC end of the window.

params.command: aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace {{ Inputs.namespace }} --metric-name {{ Inputs.metric_name }} --dimensions Name={{ Inputs.dimension_name }},Value={{ Inputs.dimension_value }} --start-time {{ Inputs.window_start }} --end-time {{ Inputs.window_end }} --period {{ Inputs.period_seconds }} --statistics Average Maximum --region {{ Inputs.region }} --output json

aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue={{ Inputs.resource_name }} --start-time {{ Inputs.window_start }} --end-time {{ Inputs.window_end }} --max-results 50 --region {{ Inputs.region }} --output json

llm_description:
Returns CloudWatch datapoints and CloudTrail activity for one AWS resource over a time window. RDS, ECS, Lambda, ALB, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, EC2 - anything with a CloudWatch metric.

This is a data tool. It fetches and returns; it does not interpret. There is no verdict, no root cause and no filtering - every CloudTrail event in the window is returned, each flagged read_only true/false, with the caller, source IP, request parameters and any error code. Deciding which of them matters is your job, not the tool's.

Set namespace, metric_name, dimension_name and dimension_value for the metric, and resource_name for the CloudTrail lookup. Widen window_start beyond the alarm if you want to see what preceded it - the tool returns exactly the window you ask for and nothing outside it.

Typical dimensions: RDS DBInstanceIdentifier, Lambda FunctionName, ECS ServiceName, ALB LoadBalancer, DynamoDB TableName, ElastiCache CacheClusterId, EC2 InstanceId. A dimension key that does not match the resource type returns zero datapoints.

For EC2 also consider ec2-investigation, which additionally returns SSM command history and can run a read-only inspection on the host.

Read-only. It never changes anything.
